text:
Amelia (CS): morning — quick sync on Verdigris private deploy. Need clarity on audit log retention across their SIEM and our S3 export, plus KMS rotation policy.
Alex (Verdigris): hi! we want 13 months retention for audit logs and a compliant KMS rotation cadence — auditor flagged 90 days. also need proof-of-delivery for logs to their Splunk endpoint.
Diego (SE): we can support 13 months via daily aggregated exports to their S3 bucket + lifecycle rule. For Splunk, we can push via our log-forwarder. KMS rotation: our platform supports automatic rotation but default is yearly.
Ruth (NetEng): network note — Splunk ingress will need our egress IPs whitelisted. Also need to confirm VPC endpoint policy for the S3 bucket. Alex, can you share the destination bucket ARN and IP ranges?
Alex (Verdigris): Bucket ARN: arn:aws:s3:::vdg-audit-logs-123; egress ranges: 34.210.0.0/16, 3.120.45.0/24. we'll try to open them this afternoon.
Sam (Security): auditors will need an immutable retention proof. We can enable object lock (WORM) on the S3 bucket if Verdigris agrees. KMS: rotation every 90 days implies scheduled rekeying. We should avoid key ARN rotation too frequently; better to rotate data keys with envelope encryption and keep CMK rotation schedule.
Diego (SE): proposal: 
- Audit pipeline: daily export -> gzip -> S3://vdg-audit-logs-123/yyyy=... -> lifecycle: transition to IA at 30d, delete at 395d (13 months)
- Object lock legal hold optional if they need immutability
- KMS: enable automatic key rotation for CMK every 90 days; we'll also support re-encrypt job for existing objects on a monthly rolling window
Ruth (NetEng): action for infra: create VPC endpoint vpce-0abc1234 with policy that restricts PutObject from our account only. I'll add the allow list for their Splunk IPs once Alex confirms.
Amelia (CS): sounds good. Alex — can you confirm legal/regulatory requirement for WORM or is immutable a 'nice to have'?
Alex (Verdigris): it's a hard requirement for finance logs only. We can scope WORM to s3://vdg-audit-logs-123/finance/* .
Sam (Security): ok we'll implement object lock at prefix level via separate buckets or prefix + replication? note: object lock is bucket-level at AWS — need separate bucket for finance if they require WORM.
Diego (SE): then plan B: create vdg-audit-logs-123-finance with object lock enabled and lifecycle for 13 months. Non-finance goes to main bucket.
Amelia (CS): timeline? we need to schedule changes before their compliance review next Wed.
Ruth (NetEng): I can provision VPCE and update endpoint policy today, need 2h. Diego can set up export job + KMS rotation config — estimate 4h. Sam will validate object lock bucket creation with infra permissions — 1h.
Amelia (CS): ok, assign owners: Ruth - VPCE + policy, Diego - export pipeline + KMS rotation + re-encrypt job, Sam - object lock bucket + compliance doc, Amelia - coordinate with Verdigris & capture auditor artifacts.
infra-bot: deploy job queued: vpce-provision-vdg -> status: pending
Diego (SE): sample config for export job:
```
redwoodctl export-audit --dest s3://vdg-audit-logs-123 --compress=gzip --schedule=daily --prefix=yyyy=MM/dd
redwoodctl kms set-rotation --key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd1234 --period-days 90
```
Alex (Verdigris): thanks — I'll open the firewall rules and confirm by 17:00 PT. Also need a short writeup for our auditors showing where logs live and rotation schedule.
Sam (Security): I'll draft the auditor note and include key fingerprints and rotation calendar. Amelia, can you collect the S3 bucket ARNs + VPCE id when ready?
Amelia (CS): will do. follow-ups: please post completed PRs in this thread. :thumbsup:
Ruth (NetEng): VPCE provisioned -> vpce-0a1b2c3d, policy attached. Asked Alex to confirm connectivity.
Alex (Verdigris): connectivity test OK from Splunk forwarder. seeing files in s3://vdg-audit-logs-123/yyyy=2026/03/21. thanks!
Diego (SE): export job deployed, initial backfill started (approx 12GB). KMS rotation scheduled, re-encrypt job queued.
Sam (Security): created finance bucket vdg-audit-logs-123-finance with object lock enabled, retention 395 days. IAM policy only allows PutObject with x-amz-server-side-encryption.
Amelia (CS): closing loop — auditors scheduled review tomorrow at 15:00 PT. Sam and Diego please be available for a quick Q&A. great work team :tada:
